title.description: Opening or section slide: large centred title with an optional subtitle.

title-body.description: Headline on top, one body region below. The workhorse layout.

two-column.description: Headline plus two side-by-side regions for comparisons or text beside an image.

hero-image.description: Full-bleed image with a title and optional caption laid over it.

big-number.description: One headline figure (use a stat element) with a short caption.

quote.description: A single pull quote with attribution.

grid-3.description: Headline plus three equal cards, e.g. three pillars or three stats.

full-bleed.description: One unconstrained region covering the whole slide.

transitions.slide: New slide slides in from the right.
transitions.zoom: New slide scales up from slightly smaller.
transitions.push: New slide pushes the old one off to the left.
transitions.morph: Elements that share an id with the previous slide glide to their new position and size; the rest crossfade.

builds.fade-up: Fades in while rising slightly. The default.
builds.typewriter: Text types in character by character (headings, text and quotes).

regionCapacityNote: Region numbers are rough character budgets used by the overflow lint; 0 means media only.
